Ways from entry screens, cheapest first:
  [launcher] MainActivity -> ViewsActivity -> ListFragment -> DetailFragment -> InfoDialog
  [deeplink https://navapp.example/views] LinkActivity -> ViewsActivity -> ListFragment -> DetailFragment -> InfoDialog
  entry kinds: launcher, deeplink, intent (manifest); base: only a base class of many screens
  opens it; outside: opened from code that is not a screen (a service, push); unknown: the map
  sees nothing that opens it. ~push~>: the step goes through push or deep link handling; (in M): a shared
  screen, this way only when a screen of module M hosts it
